statement: Implement H3 ingress/guest/client composition: complete bounded HTTP Fetch envelope fidelity (raw bytes, query order and repeated keys, application header forwarding, hop-by-hop and credential stripping, multiple Set-Cookie, HEAD/204/304 status rules, byte-distinct intent digests), awaited guest response, and request-scoped client with sequential multi-call fan-out, concurrent call refusal (unsupported_concurrency), post-return client closure (request_client_closed), and unfinished child work refusal (unfinished_child_work).
